findings.title: Fix is incomplete: other GroupAdapter methods still NPE on concurrently deleted groups
findings.body: The null guard is added only to getSubGroupsCount (line 274). Other GroupAdapter methods that delegate to the cached model via cached.getX(keycloakSession, modelSupplier) still throw NPE when the underlying group is deleted from the database. After isUpdated() returns false, modelSupplier.get() can return null and the DefaultLazyLoader invokes its function with a null source (e.g., source -> source.getSubGroupsStream().map(...).collect(...)). Affected call sites in this file: getFirstAttribute (line 149), getAttributeStream (line 155), getAttributes (line 163), hasDirectRole (line 182), hasRole (line 188), getRoleMappingsStream (line 204), getSubGroupsStream (line 240). CachedGroup.getAttributes (line 66) and CachedGroup.getSubGroups (line 90) likewise lack the null guard. The same defensive null check applied to getSubGroupsCount should be applied consistently.

findings.title: getRoleMappings null check guards the wrong variable
findings.body: The check `if (group == null)` verifies that the Supplier<GroupModel> parameter itself is null, but modelSupplier in GroupAdapter is set in the constructor and is never null. The comment indicates the intent was to handle the case where the loaded GroupModel is null, but the implementation checks the wrong variable. As a result, getRoleMappings still invokes the loader function on a null source whenever supplier.get() returns null. Any GroupAdapter method that calls cached.getRoleMappings (hasDirectRole line 182, hasRole line 188, getRoleMappingsStream line 204) remains vulnerable to NPE under the same concurrent-delete scenario that the PR is trying to address. The guard should check the result of group.get() being null.

findings.title: Reader thread is never joined; assertion can race the reader
findings.body: createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti starts an anonymous reader thread (line 139) that loops until deletedAll is true, then asserts caughtExceptions is empty immediately after setting deletedAll.set(true) (line 155). The reader thread is never joined. If the reader is mid-request when the main thread asserts, an exception thrown by that request after the assertion is added to caughtExceptions without being observed by the test. As written, the test can pass even when the bug is present (reader thread throws after the assertion completes) and can be flaky. The Thread should be captured into a local variable and thread.join() called before the assertThat.

findings.title: Cache entry is not invalidated when group is missing from DB
findings.body: When modelSupplier.get() returns null because the group was concurrently deleted from the database, getSubGroupsCount now returns null but the cache entry remains in place. Every subsequent call on the same GroupAdapter will repeat the failed DB lookup and return null again. The fix should also call cacheSession.registerGroupInvalidation(cached.getId()) (as getDelegateForUpdate does at line 59) when the model turns out to be missing, so the cached entry is removed and subsequent requests reload correctly instead of repeatedly hitting a known-missing group.
